[reply](https://news.ycombinator.com/reply?id=50195097&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833%2350195097) ![Image 3](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50195116&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833)[sleepyguy](https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=sleepyguy)[0 minutes ago](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50195116) | [prev](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50194833#50195097) | [next](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50194833#50194984)[[–]](javascript:void(0)) How I would like this to go so wrong for Cash App and the Prosecution. 10's of millions in fines but we all know the system protects these Corporations and shitty prosecutors. In the end she will have lost years of her life, her savings, etc with no restitution. [reply](https://news.ycombinator.com/reply?id=50195116&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833%2350195116) ![Image 4](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50194984&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833)[compil3d](https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=compil3d)[10 minutes ago](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50194984) | [prev](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50194833#50195116)[[–]](javascript:void(0)) I'm disgusted. How would one go about ensuring that their social couldn't be used to create an account with this much liability? Would freezing a credit line be enough? [reply](https://news.ycombinator.com/reply?id=50194984&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833%2350194984) ![Image 5](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50195027&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50194833)[LogicFailsMe](https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=LogicFailsMe)[7 minutes ago](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50195027) | [parent](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50194833#50194984)[[–]](javascript:void(0)) Prosecutors have no interest in "justice." They are measured solely on conviction rates. If she's convicted, she will go through needless life-destroying suffering because of this. But at the end, it will be overturned after the prosecutors in question have been elected to Congress or a governorship. And then lawsuits will ensue. And that's why BS like this will never stop.
